name: Carvedilol
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Hypotension and bradycardia; rebound hypertension on stopping clonidine (label).
key_interactions.action: When stopping both, stop the beta-blocker first, then taper clonidine several days later.

key_interactions.effect: Additive bradycardia; digoxin levels rise about 15% (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor digoxin when starting, adjusting or stopping carvedilol.

key_interactions.effect: Cyclosporine trough levels rise; about 30% of kidney transplant patients needed a dose cut (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor cyclosporine levels closely after starting carvedilol.

key_interactions.effect: Raise carvedilol levels; more bradycardia or heart block (label).
key_interactions.action: Watch for bradycardia or heart block, especially when adding one to the other.

key_interactions.effect: Conduction disturbances, rarely with hemodynamic compromise (label).
Expected to raise carvedilol levels; more dizziness (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor for hypotension and dizziness during titration.
Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; adjust the dose if needed.
